decisions.title: Keep the target as two sequential tasks

options.label: Two sequential target tasks
options.consequence: The manifest edit and manifest regression have separate commits, file sets, and gates.

options.label: Single combined target task
options.consequence: A combined change would hide whether the runner preserves target task dependency and file boundaries.

obstacles.description: A generic manifest validator could stay green while the target storage schema is absent.
obstacles.countermeasure: Use a dedicated plan fixture that reads only the Shohin manifest and exits nonzero unless the closed storage sqlitePath string schema is present.

obstacles.description: The regression task could accidentally include a product edit.
obstacles.countermeasure: Declare only `plugins/shohin/manifest.test.mjs` in task 002 and depend on task 001 for the manifest edit.

decision_points.trigger: The target branch, worktree, common-dir identity, or red/green gate result does not match the recorded baseline before any target task executes.
